categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches p2p_initial_headers_sync.py to fix test synchronization. The category covers testing machinery and fixes for flaky tests whose cause is in the framework, but explicitly excludes tests pinning the behavior of a particular area such as a p2p relay test.
categories.rationale: The PR fixes an intermittent race condition in p2p_initial_headers_sync.py rather than in test framework machinery. The category definition explicitly excludes tests of a particular area, noting that a p2p test belongs to that area and that flaky test fixes belong here only when their cause is in the framework.
